editorial.blurb: A genuine family-run Vietnamese spot where the pho broth sings and the clay pot catfish melts on your tongue—warm, unpretentious, and worth the trip.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the pho with chicken broth if you want the cleanest, most delicate flavor—reviewers rave about it as a go-to for hangovers or when you want to skip the parking hassle of other Viet spots.

topDishes.note: Perfectly cooked, unbelievably tender with an amazing sauce
Beautifully flavored broth, especially the chicken version
